headline: EY Publishes Claims Adjudication AI Framework. Positioning Signal.
summary: EY published a thought leadership piece on AI-powered claims adjudication in healthcare this week, signaling the firm is moving into payer-side AI automation as a practice area. Separately, McKinsey published an interview with Seema Verma on advancing American healthcare, reinforcing McKinsey's positioning as the policy-adjacent AI advisor for payers and government health programs. Both moves are competitive positioning ahead of client pitches. Firms competing in payer-side AI strategy need published frameworks now, not later.
so_what: EY published a thought leadership piece on AI-powered claims adjudication in healthcare, which is a signal that EY's health and life sciences practice is moving into payer-side AI automation. When EY publishes a framework, a client pitch deck follows within 90 days.
original_title: Reimagining healthcare through AI-powered claims adjudication
